title: Beijing Imposes a Security Law on Hong Kong
dek: China's top legislature outlaws secession, subversion, terrorism and foreign collusion in Hong Kong, and the law takes effect the same night.
body: The law took effect on 30 June 2020. Police arrested Jimmy Lai that August, and a court sentenced him to 20 years in February 2026.

panels.label: Hong Kong's Leaders Say
panels.text: Carrie Lam says the law is “a historical step” that protects “the vast majority” from “the minority” who undermine security.

panels.label: London Says
panels.text: Dominic Raab says it “constitutes a clear and serious breach” of the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side says it restored order, the other that it broke a treaty; at stake is who decides how Hong Kong governs itself.
